code: (async()=>{ const E=window.__echoes, sleep=(m)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,m)); const tr=[]; let g=0,last=0; while(g++<400){ const v=E.cmd('runState'); if(v.phase==='victory'||v.phase==='defeat'){tr.push('END '+v.phase);break;} if(v.phase==='combat'){ if(v.room!==last){last=v.room;tr.push('R'+v.room+' '+v.mode);} if(v.room===8){ await sleep(1200); E.cmd('killBoss'); E.cmd('killAllEnemies'); } else { E.cmd('killAllEnemies'); if(v.mode==='defend') E.cmd('clearRoom'); } } else if(v.phase==='reward'){E.cmd('draftTake');E.cmd('closeSocket');} else if(v.phase==='path'){E.cmd('pathChoose',0);} else if(v.phase==='shop'){E.cmd('shopAdvance');} await sleep(60);} return tr; })()

(()=>{ const all=[...document.querySelectorAll('.dmg-num')]; const vis=all.filter(n=>getComputedStyle(n).visibility==='visible'); const s=__echoes.state(); return {tag:'victory+0.2s', mode:s.vfx&&s.vfx.mode, phase:__echoes.cmd('runState').phase, domTotal:all.length, visible:vis.length, poolCount:s.vfx&&s.vfx.numerals, sample:vis.slice(0,8).map(n=>{const b=n.getBoundingClientRect(); return n.textContent+'@'+Math.round(b.x)+','+Math.round(b.y)+' o'+getComputedStyle(n).opacity;})}; })()
